requirements.text: Individuals who are completing or have recently completed a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
Experience with at least one programming language such as Python, Java, C++, Go, or JavaScript through coursework, internships, projects, or equivalent practical experience.
Successful candidates must be able to commit to an onboarding date by the end of the year. Please state your availability and graduation date clearly in your resume.

As a condition of employment, all successful candidates must be able to establish authorization to work in the United States. For this position, the Company does not provide sponsorship or any immigration-related benefits.
Experience with search, recommendation, machine learning, information retrieval, natural language processing, ranking, data mining, or backend systems.
Familiarity with distributed systems, databases, data pipelines, online experimentation, or large-scale service development.
Experience using data or metrics to debug, evaluate, or improve a product or system.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
Interest in building Search products and systems for a large-scale consumer platform.
